membership.real_rule: first 32 manifest-ordered split=dev physical visits at each of 2500000 and 5000000 samples/s
membership.timing_rule: first two selected physical visits per rate
membership.control_rule: all 12 original synthetic physical cases at 2.5/5 Msps plus all 20 lag3 adversarial physical cases

application_comparator.inventory: every qualifying pair in the full response, not only returned first

association.coordinate: within-dwell probe_start_sample + local_epoch_sample; source counters remain integer
association.injected_temporal_support: each member's actual 20 ms probe must contain at least two injected frames with complete GLRT symbols 2..65

control_sequences.gate: first pilot-bearing visit routes blind and finds the injected pilot
noise and tone visits after establishment remain inactive
changed timing/CFO routes blind and associates to the current injected pilot

sequence_mapping.counter_step_reason: 120 ms equals exactly 90 Starlink frame periods at 2.5 Msps, so repeated-array frame timing phase is preserved
sequence_mapping.carrier_phase_reset: true for every virtual occurrence; sequences test routing/state semantics and do not claim continuous RF carrier phase

stage_order: all 64 constructed control receiver rows and fixed sequences
paired timing on four selected physical visits only if all science controls pass
all 64 real physical visits and full comparator inventories only if cost gates pass
stopping_rule: Record the complete planned stage and all failures, then stop before the next stage on any gate failure; no subset is a pass.
